name: o23494

schema.title: MovesList
schema.description: A list of moves played by each child

split.description: Whether the split is made in this move or not

pause.description: Whether the child comes to stand still or not

relativeangle.description: Angle relative to the current angle

ejectmass.description: Whether the child ejects mass or not

description: During the latest simulation run, three child agents executed distinct moves. Child 0 remained whole (no split), paused briefly, adjusted its heading by a positive 45.5° relative to its current orientation, and did not eject any mass. Child 1 performed a split, stayed active without pausing, rotated sharply by –120.0°, and released mass at that moment. Finally, Child 2 neither split nor paused, kept its heading unchanged (0° relative angle), and also refrained from ejecting mass.
